catalog.title: My Desired Home
catalog.description: East-facing 60 × 55 ft home: garden-facing care suite, compact rear caregiver suite and lawn, rear veranda, longer parking approach, separate drawing room with three doors and a double-height family living hall.

catalog.title: My Desired Home · Inside the Wires
catalog.description: A separate copy of the veranda house with an interactive, India-focused electrical tour. Explore the meter, boards, protected circuits and concealed route traces.

catalog.title: The Bungalow
catalog.description: A large 100 × 130 ft G+1 government bungalow recreated from the owner's photographs: red comb-frieze parapets, a grilled entrance verandah beside a corrugated carport, a grand drawing hall and dining hall in teak and cane, four bedrooms, ceiling fans and 3.6 m ceilings, a big clipped lawn, rose-covered fences, neem, mango and Ashoka trees.

catalog.title: The Aangan House
catalog.description: A single-storey courtyard home on a 55 × 80 ft plot: every room opens to an aangan with a mango tree. Opens as its own drawing; scroll to walk in.

catalog.title: The Long House
catalog.description: A G+1 home on a 30 × 60 ft plot laid on one line: living, a light court open to the sky, dining, kitchen and garden. Opens as its own drawing; scroll to walk in.

catalog.title: Your saved Verandah House
